subject: Hybrid compliance packaging: pricing, proofing, and billing model questions
messages:
From: Ellen Fisher <ellen.fisher@medsyn.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medsyn.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Clarify fees for audit logs / HSM / residency — draft asks

Aditya,

Thanks for sending over the outline during the call. Before we take this to procurement, a few clarifying questions from my side so we can avoid back-and-forth:

- For audit logs: is the tiered per-GB pricing in that worksheet the one-off ingestion charge or a recurring monthly ingest+retention fee? We need a clean line item for forecast.
- For HSM: your team quoted both a per-seat HSM admin license and an alternative throughput-based pass-through. Is there a blended option (small seat + throughput) we can propose for pilot?
- Residency: we prefer activation-as-capex rather than a monthly surcharge if possible. Is Redwood open to a one-time activation fee + lower monthly egress cap?

We're trying to map this into our FY27 budget; any amortization examples (2-year vs 3-year) you can share would be useful. I attached the initial procurement template for your redlines.

Ellen
Director, Platform Ops
MedSyn Health

Attachment: MedSyn_Procurement_Template.xlsx (referenced)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Fisher <ellen.fisher@medsyn.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Clarify fees for audit logs / HSM / residency — draft asks

Hi Ellen — thanks, great questions. I put together a short readout and a proposed split so procurement has concrete options. Summary below; full line-item worksheet attached (MedSyn_Compliance_Pricing_Worksheet.xlsx).

Key proposals:
1) Audit logs
   - Ingest fee: $0.08 per GB for month 0 (first ingestion), then recurring retention fee of $0.02 per GB/month for retention beyond 30 days.
   - Tier break: >25TB/month drops ingest to $0.06/GB, retention drops to $0.015/GB/month.
   - Option: flat monthly retention cap (e.g., $2,500/mo) for predictable billing at pilot scale.

2) HSM/KMS
   - Seat model: $1,500 per HSM admin seat / month (includes key rotation & audit tooling); one-time onboarding/attestation $12,000 (installation, attestation, config).
   - Throughput model: $0.012 per 1,000 key operations; recommended for high-volume stateless workloads.
   - Hybrid (pilot) propose: 1 admin seat + throughput at 50% list = seat ($1,500/mo) + $0.006 per 1k ops. We can amortize onboarding over 24 months to match budget preferences.

3) Residency / Data Sovereignty
   - Activation fee (one-time): $45,000 for a dedicated VPC + regional compliance checks.
   - Residency surcharge: $0.006 per token for regional routing (if monthly model preferred).
   - We can offer a trade: one-time activation at 60% list + 12-month commitment with reduced monthly residency surcharge.

Discounting / packaging note:
- For pilots (<=12 months) we typically offer 15% off the compliance bundle (audit logs + 1 HSM seat + residency activation) with a 12-month revenue commitment.
- For a 24-month committed agreement and minimum ARR threshold ($400k ARR), we can extend to 25% bundle discount and amortize onboarding credits across months.

Next steps I suggest:
- Which of the three options do you want procurement to see (line items only, blended pilot, or committed 24-month)?
- If you want the amortized excel, Ben (CC'd) will draft the ARR schedule.

Thanks — attaching the detailed worksheet.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: MedSyn_Compliance_Pricing_Worksheet.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Hybrid compliance packaging: pricing, proofing, and billing model questions

Aditya / team — I ran three amortization scenarios and pasted quick numbers below (full calc in worksheet):

Scenario A — Pilot (12 months), no ARR commit
  - One-time onboarding (HSM+residency): $57,000 (list) -> Redwood pilot concession: -15% = $48,450
  - Estimated monthly usage (audit + HSM throughput + seat): $9,200/mo -> annualized $110,400
  - Effective TCV (12mo): $158,850

Scenario B — 24-month commit (min $400k ARR)
  - Onboarding amortized 24mo: $57,000 /24 = $2,375/mo
  - Monthly usage (discounted bundle): $7,850/mo -> annualized $188,400
  - Applied 25% compliance bundle discount -> net TCV: $182,400

Scenario C — Hybrid billing (cap + overage) for predictability
  - Set a monthly cap of $7,000 (includes retention cap), overage billed at tier rates
  - Upfront activation offset: $30k (reduced activation for cap model)

Notes and ask:
- Laura: can you confirm whether finance is okay with a 24-month amortization period for the onboarding fee as a concession? That materially improves the monthly OPEX for MedSyn.
- Ellen / Procurement: we can produce a line-by-line redline-friendly SOW and a DocuSign envelope once you confirm which scenario procurement prefers.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_amortization_tab (embedded into MedSyn_Compliance_Pricing_Worksheet.xlsx)

From: Ellen Fisher <ellen.fisher@medsyn.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medsyn.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Hybrid compliance packaging: pricing, proofing, and billing model questions

Thanks — this is helpful. Procurement prefers Scenario C (cap + overage) but with the following asks before legal signs:

- Cap definition: monthly cap must include retention storage but exclude extraordinary egress (e.g., export >1TB/month). Can you call that out in the SOW?
- Evidence: we need monthly proof-of-delivery for audit logs (checksum + sample ingest) and a quarterly HSM attestation. Can you add evidence delivery SLA into SOW?
- DocuSign: procurement will need a standard redline window of 3 business days. If you can send the SOW with the cap numbers and the evidence clause, I'll circulate.

Also, the procurement team flagged the one-time activation fee as high for their budget cycle. If Redwood will reduce the activation fee to $30k with a 12-month cap model (Scenario C), procurement is willing to sign quickly.

Ellen
